description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss for two different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.00 to 1.25e9, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.25e9. The y-axis is labeled “Loss”, has a linear scale, ranges from 2.40 to 2.75, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 2.72 at x=0.00 and decreases to approximately 2.52 at x=1.25e9, with a peak decline between x=0.00 and x=0.25e9. A red line, without a specific label, begins at approximately 2.68 at x=0.00 and decreases to approximately 2.51 at x=1.25e9, with a peak decline between x=0.00 and x=0.50e9.
